entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: Governing body of Ghirapur whose enforcers, thopter spies and blockades the renegades oppose.

entities.name: Renegades
entities.description: Rebels of Ghirapur and Kaladesh who rose in revolt against Consulate control.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: Inventor and renegade whose passion is directed at making real, lasting change.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker who wonders how the consuls can be blind to Tezzeret's manipulations.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker and manipulator behind events on Kaladesh who built the Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Baral, Chief of Compliance
entities.description: Consulate officer who hunts the renegades.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker who comments on the plane's replication of magical techniques.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: Consulate figure who sabotaged the Heart of Kiran and boasts of walkers.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker driven by anger at the man who took her father from her; answered Dovin Baan's sabotage with an explosion.

entities.name: Kari Zev
entities.description: Skyship raider who captains the Dragon's Smile and follows no one's rules but her own.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Planeswalker who vows to protect the weak and urges stopping Tezzeret's schemes.

entities.name: Rishkar
entities.description: Renegade of Peema.

entities.name: Saheeli Rai
entities.description: Artificer who condemns the Peacewalker Colossus as an instrument of fear.

entities.name: Gonti
entities.description: Crime lord sustained by an aether heart who sees opportunity in the revolution.

entities.name: Sram, Senior Edificer
entities.description: Edificer who worries about keeping the city's machinery balanced as conflict grows.

entities.name: Yahenni, Undying Partisan
entities.description: Aetherborn who joined the revolt, pushed to her limit by the Consulate.

entities.name: Kadhu
entities.description: Skywhaler.

entities.name: Nadja Cloudtoucher
entities.description: Aerowright inspired by wild drakes.

entities.name: Jasi Ganin
entities.description: Master siphoner who urges slowing the Consulate.

entities.name: Ara
entities.description: Renegade smuggler.

entities.name: Karavin
entities.description: Renegade saboteur.

entities.name: Kurna Majan
entities.description: Member of the Luminary League.

entities.name: Kershan Danil
entities.description: Highspire artisan.

entities.name: Nirav
entities.description: Tirahar elder who believes all inventions return to the soil.

entities.name: Oviya Pashiri
entities.description: Sage lifecrafter.

entities.name: Surash
entities.description: Keeper of the Cowl.

entities.name: Venkat Dasai
entities.description: Renegade commander.

entities.name: Bes Tavani
entities.description: Bomat merchant.

entities.name: Enforcer-Chief Ranaj
entities.description: Consulate enforcer-chief.

entities.name: Venand Kapur
entities.description: The Gearherder.

entities.name: Ivash
entities.description: Consulate inventor.

entities.name: Thamaz
entities.description: Weldfast inventor.

entities.name: Irsi
entities.description: Kujar gardener.

entities.name: League of Aeronauts
entities.description: Organization from which the Consulate recruits its best pilots.

entities.name: Derby Crows
entities.description: Daredevil racers long at odds with the Consulate who joined the revolt.

entities.name: Wind-Kin
entities.description: Small aeronaut society that sided with the renegades.

entities.name: Scrappers
entities.description: Underground group of automaton brawlers with renegade leanings who lent brawlers to the conflict.

entities.name: Ghirapur
entities.description: City of Kaladesh gripped by revolt.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: Plane whose aether is described as the soul all souls should be free of control.

entities.name: Aether Spire
entities.description: Spire in Ghirapur toward which renegade forces closed in.

entities.name: Bastion of the Honorable
entities.description: Headquarters of the Consulate's enforcers.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: Tezzeret's device that the renegades sought to destroy with an aether disruptor.

entities.name: Heart of Kiran
entities.description: Vehicle in whose hold Chandra answered Dovin Baan's sabotage.

entities.name: Dragon's Smile
entities.description: Kari Zev's ship.

entities.name: The Hold
entities.description: Illegal research facility in a derelict merchant ship that became a wellspring of renegade intelligence.

entities.name: Peema
entities.description: Aether-rich forest region of Kaladesh.

entities.name: Great Conduit
entities.description: Flow of aether said to connect all.

entities.name: Inventors' Fair
entities.description: Fair that showed thousands of devices the Consulate gained access to.

events.summary: Pia Nalaar mourns that the Consulate seized the inventors' workshops and creations.
events.quote: The workshops are silent. Our creations have been seized.

events.summary: Gideon wonders how the consuls can be blind to Tezzeret's manipulations.
events.quote: how can the consuls be so blind to Tezzeret's manipulations?

events.summary: Renegade forces closed in on the Aether Spire as Consulate blockades failed one by one.
events.quote: As renegade forces closed in on the Aether Spire, Consulate blockades failed one by one.

events.summary: The Derby Crows joined the renegades in open revolt.
events.quote: were quick to join the renegades in open revolt

events.summary: Wind-Kin aeronauts sided with the renegades.
events.quote: Small aeronaut societies like the Wind-Kin had little to lose by siding with the renegades

events.summary: Tezzeret tells the renegades the machine is in motion and their effort is too late.
events.quote: Too little, too late. The machine is in motion.

events.summary: Tezzeret tells his foes the matter is bigger than them.
events.quote: This is bigger than you. All of you.

events.summary: Tezzeret completes the Planar Bridge, declaring the real work can begin.
events.quote: It is finished. Now the real work can begin.

events.summary: Tezzeret tells his foes they cannot comprehend the plans in motion.
events.quote: You can't hope to comprehend the plans that are in motion.

events.summary: The renegades mounted an aether disruptor aboard a thopter to destroy Tezzeret's Planar Bridge.
events.quote: The renegades mounted an aether disruptor aboard a lightweight thopter to destroy Tezzeret's Planar Bridge.

events.summary: Renegades salvaged the shattered gearhulk to the renegade foundry.
events.quote: When the salvage team brought in the shattered gearhulk, a wave of excitement swept through the renegade foundry.

events.summary: In the hold of the Heart of Kiran, Chandra answered Dovin Baan's sabotage with an explosive retort.
events.quote: In the hold of the *Heart of Kiran*, Chandra answered Dovin Baan's sabotage with an explosive retort.

events.summary: Fighting spilled over into Giant's Walk, angering the normally placid giants.
events.quote: When fighting spilled over into Giant's Walk, the aether weapons and swooping airships angered the normally placid creatures.

events.summary: Chandra is driven by anger at the man who took her father from her.
events.quote: Chandra was driven by her anger, directed particularly at the man who had taken her father from her.

events.summary: Ajani vows to protect the weak and urges stopping Tezzeret's schemes.
events.quote: Tezzeret's schemes must be stopped!

events.summary: Saheeli condemns the Peacewalker Colossus as serving only fear.
events.quote: Its sole purpose is fear.

events.summary: Consulate turned devices from the Inventors' Fair into instruments of oppression.
events.quote: A few small changes transformed some of them from marvels of ingenuity to instruments of oppression.

events.summary: Gonti sees the revolution as beneficial to his enterprises.
events.quote: all our enterprises can benefit from this little revolution

events.summary: Yahenni announces that the time for subtlety is over.
events.quote: The time for subtlety is over, darling.

events.summary: Rishkar declares aether the soul of Kaladesh and that all souls should be free.
events.quote: Aether is the soul of Kaladesh, and all souls should be free.

events.summary: Surash says the wilds will abandon restraint as the Consulate has.
events.quote: If the Consulate has abandoned restraint, so too shall the wilds.

events.summary: Venkat Dasai rallies renegades to give the Consulate a taste of its own medicine.
events.quote: The Consulate sought to crush us. Let's give them a taste of their own medicine.

events.summary: Jace comments on the plane's people replicating magic without a natural gift.
events.quote: It is fascinating to see how the people of this plane replicate magical techniques without a natural gift.

relations.quote: It didn't take long for them to lend their best brawlers to the conflict.
